title: Keith Scandone on where O3 is going
excerpt: Keith Scandone joined Marcia O'Connor on The Top 3 podcast.

cardMedia.alt: Keith Scandone giving an impassioned speech at the office.

children.text: O3 Co-Founder and CEO, Keith Scandone joined Marcia O’Connor on The Top 3 podcast recently to share a few lessons he’s learned. Keith points out that perseverance, patience and perspective have been the keys to O3’s success over the past 16 years.
Listen to Keith’s insights on how O3 has made an effort to pivot and make an impact on a grander scale each year.

seo.description: Keith Scandone joined Marcia O'Connor on The Top 3 podcast to discuss O3’s keys to success over the years and lessons learned along the way.
